issues.quote: revenue rising 24.6% to $716.9 billion from $638.0 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: The growth rate is wrong. $716.9B / $638.0B − 1 ≈ 12.4%, not 24.6%.

data.summary: The revenue growth rate is overstated: it is about 12.4%, not 24.6%. The other figures, including net income growth of about 31%, look consistent.
